reason: The idea of one place where my gym log, budget and class stuff talk to each other is exactly my problem, but I'd poke at the free tier at most, and five apps free is enough to see if it sticks before I pay anything on a stipend. Realistically my notes, my budget sheet and my lifting app all have years of stuff in them, and I'm not rebuilding that mid-semester.
objection: Moving my existing notes over sounds like a weekend of work, and if the assistant files things in the wrong place I'm now checking drafts in a sixth app instead of using five.
would_change_my_mind: A one-tap import that pulls in my existing notes, budget and workout history and actually gets it right, so I'm not starting from zero.
